comparison.title: Mac Sai vs Breathing Room: modules or investigation?
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose a Mac maintenance workflow, not a security benchmark.
comparison.recommendation: Mac Sai merits consideration for its documented free module suite. Breathing Room, which we build, may fit reviewable investigations and activity-history needs if its preview/runtime and hosted-AI constraints are acceptable. Neither is a guaranteed safer or faster choice.

macSai: Documented free suite includes uninstaller, treemap, duplicate tools and malware-pattern scanning; no subscription advertised.
Vendor states Developer ID/notarized distribution; unlike Breathing Room's disclosed non-notarized preview, but no independent signature inspection here.
Requires macOS 14+ for the checked release; potentially destructive maintenance/shredder modes require distinct caution.
No blanket safety, full antivirus efficacy or complete privacy guarantees established.
breathingRoom: Source register supports grouped app monitoring, activity history and constrained investigation/approval flows; not proof of distributed binary parity.
Free local desktop scope is distinct from authenticated hosted AI Care; disclose network/data boundary and recurring prices.
macOS 13+ advertised but Python 3.10+ required for inventory; non-notarized preview and incomplete native QA remain material limits.
Do not imply Mac Sai lacks monitoring, developer cleanup, permissions controls or review features.
